result_text:
The `mock` scoping rule now matches any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock`, wherever it sits in the path and whatever follows the prefix. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes (332 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped), including a new test for the new cases.

**Change**
- `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`: the two rules `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` are replaced by one rule, `(.*[/\\])?(__)?mock[^/\\]*[/\\].*`. The folder name is matched as a whole segment, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` stay out. Backslash paths are handled by the character classes and by the existing path-variant matching in `SourceFileFilter`.
- `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java` (new): covers the plain `mock/`, punctuation (`mock.data`, `mock(old)`), non-ASCII (`mock-größe`, `mock模拟`), backslash paths, every folder kind that was already test code, and the negative cases.

Nothing is committed.
